Kuj Waday Kar Ke Zainab Maqtal Cho Tur Payi Aye.
Kyun Sadmay Laine Chan Veran Ki Behan Mar Gayi Aye.

1
Hun Chain Naal Sowein Har Dard Bhul Ke Veeran.
Sar Uriyaan Chadar Dardaan Di Haye Behan Orhdi Aye.
Gham Marda Aye Zalim Babe Di Judai Da.
Sochein Na Zulm Tun Haye Tere Masooma Dar Gayi Aye.

2
Safraan De Wich Sanbhale Mastoraan Te Balaan Nu.
Kadi Maa Ban Ke Kadi Piyo Ban Ke Har Farz Nibhandi Aye.
 Zeshaan Bazaraan Te Darbar Qaid Khane.
Har Moor Te Zainab Khud Mar Ke Naa Rab Da Bacha Gayi Aye.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/kuj-waday-kar-ke-zainab-maqtal-cho-tur-payi-aye-lyrics-punjabi-2016-tajpoints-645eab3bfbd076a3af2e.md')
_, metadata, source = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def shape(lyrics, numbers):
    return [(block.splitlines()[0].strip() if i else '', len(block.splitlines()) - bool(i)) for i, block in enumerate(lyrics.strip().translate(numbers).split('\\n\\n'))]
assert shape(roman, {}) == shape(source, str.maketrans('۱۲', '12')) == [('', 2), ('1', 4), ('2', 4)]
assert 'lang: \"pa-Arab\"' in metadata and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and '\\u200c' not in source
print('Verified a two-verse opening and two four-verse stanzas in both scripts.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Shahmukhi Punjabi text in the selected Markdown file and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have a two-verse opening and two four-verse stanzas. Updated the titles and script metadata and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous Roman `veran` as `ویراں`, consistent with the later `veeran`.
